paginas.pregunta: Write a short paragraph (50-80 words) describing your ideal weekend. Use at least 3 different verb tenses and 2 phrasal verbs.
paginas.guia_evaluacion: Check for: 1) Variety of verb tenses (present, past, future, perfect), 2) Correct use of at least 2 phrasal verbs, 3) Coherent paragraph structure, 4) Appropriate vocabulary
paginas.respuesta_sugerida: My ideal weekend starts with sleeping in late on Saturday. I usually meet up with friends for brunch, then we hang out at a park. In the afternoon, I'll have finished my chores and can relax. On Sunday, I'm going to try a new recipe and catch up on reading before the week begins.

paginas.pregunta:
Rewrite the following sentences using the words in parentheses without changing the meaning:
1. 'You must not smoke here.' (allowed)
2. 'I regret not studying more.' (wish)
3. 'They will finish the project by Friday.' (have been finished)
paginas.guia_evaluacion:
Expected answers:
1. You are not allowed to smoke here.
2. I wish I had studied more.
3. The project will have been finished by Friday.
paginas.respuesta_sugerida:
1. You are not allowed to smoke here.
2. I wish I had studied more.
3. The project will have been finished by Friday.
